preconditions.description: n is the number of tournaments (1 ≤ n ≤ 5·10^4) and k is the number of sport kinds (1 ≤ k ≤ 10).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == k for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines contains exactly k integers representing the power of the i-th sportsman in each sport kind.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(sij) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for sij in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each power sij is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(sij for sij in line.split())) == k for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For any sport kind, all powers are distinct across sportsmen.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(len(possible_winners_for_tournament(i))) for i in range(1, n+1)) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each tournament i (1 ≤ i ≤ n), output the number of possible winners, where possible_winners_for_tournament(i) is the set of sportsmen who can win the tournament with i participants.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= i for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines(), 1))
postconditions.description: The number of possible winners for the i-th tournament is between 1 and i inclusive.
